summary: Backend-only verification of POST /api/workers-chat (HR AI assistant) using the Gemini key added to backend/.env. Created pytest suite (3 tests) covering: single-worker grounded reply, multi-worker branch comparison, and empty-workers graceful handling. All 3 tests passed against http://localhost:8001. Sample reply confirmed grounded in provided data (references worker name 'Rəşad Əliyev', exact figures 6,200 AZN, 120% icra, 88% reytinq, 300 AZN bonus) and returned in Azerbaijani. No 500s, no hallucinated workers/branches.
critical_code_review_comments: GEMINI_API_KEY is read at import time (line 31) — if the key is rotated in .env, backend must be restarted. Acceptable, but worth noting.
test_credentials: N/A — /api/workers-chat has no auth (per request); frontend admin login skipped as instructed.
seed_data_creation: None — payloads built in-test, no DB writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Workers HR AI chat (/api/workers-chat) fully verified in iteration_25. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_workers_chat.py as regression. Frontend Workers page still requires admin (Firebase role=admin) login — no test creds available.
rca of the issue: Root cause was missing GEMINI_API_KEY in /app/backend/.env (endpoint returned 503 'AI service is not configured'). Main agent added the key; backend was restarted; endpoint now returns HTTP 200 with grounded Azerbaijani HR analytics replies. Fix verified.
